paragraphs.text: Floating overlay that surfaces pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session,
Global approval / question reminder overlay for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
When any session has a pending tool approval, a plan review, or a user question, a persistent floati
ng overlay pops up at the bottom-right of the DSH web UI (draggable, collapsible). Clicking an entry
jumps straight to the session that needs you, so approvals never stall the flow because they are ou
ight to the session that needs you, so approvals never stall the flow because they are out of sight.
- The host half (`lib/index.js`) is intentionally empty — all behavior lives in the browser half (`l

ib/client.js`), which registers a shell overlay entry.
- The `dsh.client` manifest injects the brows
er half into the web client runtime.
Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bund
le stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.
